title: Cut stone for the {place}
Ashlar for the walls
summary: The masons of {settlement} have laid their last cut stone into the {place}. {count} × {item} are needed.
offer: Rubble will do for the footings, but the walls of the {place} must be square. {count} × {item}, and I pay well above market.
Our banker mason has nothing left to set. Bring {count} × {item} for the {place}?
progress: The mortar is going off in the tub.
complete: Clean edges, square faces. That is proper work.
The {place} rises again tomorrow. Thank you.
